title: RunDesktopResolution

kind.description: Which desktop a session's runs may drive: none, contained (the run environment's configured contained desktop) or local (this person's live desktop).

requested.description: The desktop a session's next run may drive; omitted, none.

kind.description: Which desktop a session's runs may drive: none, contained (the run environment's configured contained desktop) or local (this person's live desktop).

desktop.description: The desktop the run drives, fixed for the run; never another than requested, only none in its place.

reason.description: Why the run's desktop is what it is: selected (as requested), none (none requested), operator-disabled (desktop.contained.allowRuns is off), unavailable, unattended (a live desktop on an unattended run), containment (a live desktop under workspace containment), relay-unavailable.

message.description: The sentence the model and the person read about the resolution.

description: A run's desktop, resolved once at its start beside its policy.
